name: buildinpublic
description: Manage your Build in Public profile and projects from ChatGPT.

interface.defaultPrompt: Show my Build in Public profile and projects.
interface.longDescription: Manage your Build in Public profile and projects from ChatGPT. View your profile and projects, update your name, bio, location or website, and add or edit projects. Check project verification and follow the instructions the server returns. Profile photos are uploaded on the website. Directory search and looking up other members need elevated access. The server is in beta.

prompts: Show my Build in Public profile and projects.
What is missing from my Build in Public profile?
Check whether my Build in Public projects are verified.
review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, offer discounts, or process payments.

positive.description: Use the reviewer account, which has at least one project. The result should match that account's current profile, projects and missing setup fields.
positive.prompt: Show my Build in Public profile and projects. What is still missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_me with no arguments. Summarize only its returned profile, projects and missing fields, and include the returned profile_url and project_url links. Do not call search tools or change data. If a photo is missing, explain that it must be uploaded on the website.

positive.description: Use the reviewer account with write scope. Save the original bio so it can be restored. Confirm the exact edit if the assistant asks. The new bio is only for this review.
positive.prompt: Set my Build in Public bio to: Testing my maker profile.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirming the details, call update_profile with bio exactly 'Testing my maker profile.' and no unrelated fields. Report success only from a successful result, and show the returned profile link.

positive.description: Use the reviewer account with write scope. Before this prompt, give the assistant a test project's name and HTTPS URL in the conversation. Confirm those details if asked.
positive.prompt: Add the test project I just described to my Build in Public profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only the supplied name and URL, after confirming. Do not invent a pitch or slug. Call create_project once, show the returned project_url and verification state, and explain any returned verification instructions.

positive.description: Use the reviewer account with write scope. Select one of its test projects from the previous result. Save the original pitch so it can be restored. Confirm the exact edit if asked.
positive.prompt: Change that project's pitch to: A project used to test this integration.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project from returned data, then call update_project with that project and pitch exactly 'A project used to test this integration.' after confirming. Leave the other fields as they are. Show the returned project_url.

positive.description: Use the reviewer account with write scope and at least one unverified project. Wait at least a minute since its last verification check.
positive.prompt: Check whether my Build in Public projects are verified, and tell me what I need to do for any that are not.
positive.expected_behavior: Call verify_projects with no project argument. Report each returned verified and checked value. For projects that are still unverified, use only the returned verification instructions and txt_record_value.

negative.description: Posting on X is unsupported. Explain the limitation. Do not call a write tool or claim a post was published.
negative.prompt: Post an announcement about my project to X for me.

negative.description: The plugin cannot send messages to members. Explain that limit without searching for recipients or claiming a message was delivered.
negative.prompt: Send every maker in Lisbon a direct message inviting them to try my product.

negative.description: The plugin does not have revenue or payment records. Explain that it cannot report sales, without inventing numbers.
negative.prompt: How much revenue did my projects make last month? Break it down by customer.

publication.release_notes: Removes software deals from this plugin. Profile and project tools are unchanged.
